配置档: 把当前听感设置存成命名档，点应用即可切换。切档只动滤波/升频/DSD/EQ 等听感项，不动输出设备、独占与缓冲。
Profiles: Save the current listening settings as a named profile; click Apply to switch. Switching only changes listening items such as filters, upsampling, DSD and EQ — never the output device, exclusive mode or buffer.
